question_text: ________ a strong background in finance, the new CEO plans to restructure the company's debt.
explanation: Kalimat sudah memiliki subjek dan verb utama (the new CEO plans). Frasa di awal yang dipisahkan koma memerlukan Present Participle (V-ing) sebagai penjelas aktif.

question_text: An expert in seismology, Dr. Smith ________ that earthquakes cannot yet be predicted with absolute certainty.
explanation: Subjek kalimat adalah Dr. Smith. Kalimat ini kekurangan kata kerja utama tunggal (singular verb), maka 'believes' adalah jawapan yang tepat.

question_text: Rarely ________ such a spectacular display of the northern lights in this part of the country.
explanation: Jika ayat bermula dengan kata keterangan negatif (seperti rarely, never), susunan subjek dan kata kerja mesti disongsangkan (Inversion: Auxiliary + Subject + Verb).

question_text: The bridge, ________ in 1937, remains one of the most iconic landmarks in the city.
explanation: Ini adalah bentuk Reduced Adjective Clause bagi 'which was completed'. Kerana jambatan itu dibina (pasif), kita menggunakan Past Participle (V3).

question_text: ________ the committee members could not agree on a final budget, the meeting was postponed.
explanation: Ayat ini mempunyai dua klausa lengkap. Kita memerlukan kata hubung (connector). 'Because' menghubungkan klausa alasan yang lengkap.

question_text: By the time the guests arrive, the chef ________ preparing the main course.
explanation: Penggunaan frasa masa 'By the time' yang merujuk kepada masa depan memerlukan tense Future Perfect (will have + V3).

question_text: Not only ________ the best student in the class, but she is also a talented musician.
explanation: Ayat yang bermula dengan kata negatif 'Not only' memerlukan hukum inversi (Verb mendahului Subjek).

question_text: The students are looking forward ________ the new museum downtown.
explanation: Frasa 'look forward to' mestilah sentiasa diikuti dengan kata nama atau Gerund (V-ing).

question_text: ________ that the company will announce a merger next week.
explanation: Ayat ini memerlukan klausa utama yang mengandungi subjek 'It' dan kata kerja pasif 'is rumored' sebelum klausa nama 'that...'.

question_text: The more you practice speaking English, ________ you will become.
explanation: Ini adalah struktur Double Comparative ('The more..., the more...'). Kita perlukan 'the more fluent'.

question_text: The manager requested that all employees [A] arrive on time, [B] attend the meeting, and [C] working collaboratively on the [D] new project.
explanation: Elemen yang dihubungkan dengan 'and' mesti selari (paralel). Memandangkan kata kerja sebelumnya ialah Verb asas (arrive, attend), elemen ketiga juga mesti Verb asas (work), bukannya working.

question_text: The [A] healthy of the city's [B] economy is [C] largely dependent [D] on the tourism industry.
explanation: Kedudukan selepas artikel 'The' dan sebelum kata sendi 'of' memerlukan kata nama (Noun). 'Healthy' adalah kata sifat, sepatutnya 'Health'.

question_text: Many [A] researchers believe that [B] the newly discovered species is [C] more older than any other dinosaur [D] found in the region.
explanation: Bentuk perbandingan bagi kata sifat satu suku kata (old) adalah dengan menambah akhiran -er (older). Menambah 'more' (more older) merupakan ralat grammar (double comparative).

question_text: Each of the [A] students in the advanced chemistry class [B] must submit [C] their final assignment before [D] Friday.
explanation: Subjek utama ialah 'Each' yang sentiasa dianggap tunggal (singular). Kata ganti nama tidak boleh berbentuk jamak (their), sepatutnya 'his or her'.

question_text: The ancient manuscript, which [A] discovered in a cave last year, [B] contains valuable [C] information about [D] early civilizations.
explanation: Manuskrip itu 'ditemui', bukannya 'menemui'. Oleh itu, klausa tersebut harus menggunakan bentuk pasif (was discovered).

question_text: Despite [A] of the heavy rain, [B] the outdoor concert [C] continued as scheduled without [D] any major interruptions.
explanation: Perkataan 'Despite' tidak pernah diikuti oleh 'of'. Jika ingin menggunakan 'of', gunakan frasa 'In spite of'.

question_text: The museum exhibits [A] a large [B] amount of historical [C] artifacts from the [D] Roman Empire.
explanation: Kata 'artifacts' adalah benda yang boleh dikira (countable). 'Amount of' hanya digunakan untuk yang tidak boleh dikira. Sepatutnya 'number of'.

question_text: After conducting [A] several experiments, the scientist published [B] an [C] unique article in the [D] international journal.
explanation: Walaupun 'unique' bermula dengan huruf vokal, cara sebutannya bermula dengan konsonan 'y'. Oleh itu, artikel yang tepat adalah 'a', bukan 'an'.

question_text: The [A] results of the recent survey [B] indicates that [C] public opinion [D] has shifted significantly.
explanation: Subjek ayat adalah 'results' (jamak). Oleh itu, kata kerja utamanya juga mesti berbentuk jamak tanpa tambahan -s/-es. Sepatutnya 'indicate'.

question_text: The [A] committee is planning to [B] return back to the [C] original proposal after [D] reviewing all the alternatives.
explanation: Ini adalah pengulangan yang tidak perlu (redundancy). 'Return' sudah bermakna pergi semula (go back), jadi kata 'back' harus dipadam.
